messages:
Lara Chen: Heads up — Northpoint emailed asking for a completed SIG questionnaire and a short writeup on our private deployment options. They want answers by EOW (Fri) to move forward with procurement. Can someone lead the Q-by-Q?
Devon Park: I can take the technical Qs (network, KMS, on-prem). Need the evidence artifacts — certs, config snippets, and a short narrative per control.
Mina Ortiz: I can own the security narratives and provide the SOC2/ISO pointers + KMS rotation details. @Devon, do you want the KMS key policy and sample rotation command or do you want me to paste it here? :mag_right:
Devon Park: Paste here please. I'll adapt for the SIG fields and attach to Confluence afterwards.
Mina Ortiz: Cool. Minimal snippet for AWS KMS rotation we usually reference:
```bash
# enable automatic rotation for a CMK
aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id alias/redwood-inference-cmk
```
Add note: for Private deployments customers can use their KMS/HSM via our connector; we provide audit logs export.
Riley Stone: Quick logistics — client expects one consolidated ZIP with: answered questionnaire, attachments (cert PDFs), architecture diagram, and a short runbook for on-prem onboarding. Timeline: draft by Thu EOD, final by Fri noon. Anyone blocked?
Lara Chen: No blockers from AE side. I'll confirm which SIG version they want (v4 vs v5). They mentioned SIG 2023 format but also asked CAIQ mapping — might want both.
Devon Park: For CAIQ mapping I can produce a CSV mapping SIG question -> doc link. Will also include how our routing/fallback works (hosted -> dedicated -> private). Keep the answer concise: policy + artifact link.
Mina Ortiz: For answers where we say "customer-managed keys" we need to point to the specific KMS integration doc and the audit log export example (CloudTrail path + sample log). I'll attach sanitized sample logs.
Lara Chen: I'll hunt down the SOC2 cert and third-party pentest report links. Riley — can you zip last year's reports and upload to the shared folder?
Riley Stone: On it. Uploading to: https://redwoodapps.internal/sales/northpoint/sig-evidence (perm: sales + security). ETA 20m. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Attached: SOC2_type2_2025.pdf to channel (shared by Riley Stone).
Devon Park: Two quick Qs that often block review: 1) Do we provide a control narrative for 'separation of duties' that references our RBAC and audit trails? 2) For 'change management' do we include our release cadence + deploy safety checks?
Mina Ortiz: 1) Yes — RBAC + IAM policies + audit logs. I'll draft a 3-sentence narrative and attach the IAM policy JSON (sanitized). 2) For change mgmt include canary+rollbacks, pre-deploy tests, and runbook reference.
Lara Chen: If you both draft those, I can slot them into the questionnaire text fields. Also need a short note about data residency for EMEA — we host EU data in eu-1 region; mention optional Private deployment for on-prem.
Devon Park: Drafting architecture diagram now (will attach PNG). Include network flow: client -> ALB -> inference pool -> metrics exporter.
Riley Stone: Upload complete — SOC2 + ISO cert + pentest summary are in the folder. I'll create the ZIP and add a manifest.json listing artifacts.
Mina Ortiz: Draft narratives posted to Confluence: https://docs.redwood.internal/security/sig-northpoint (visibility: sales+security). I'll redact any sensitive identifiers.
Devon Park: Draft spreadsheet mapping (SIG -> artifact) posted. I'll mark cells needing a short narrative with "SE DRAFT".
Lara Chen: Great. I'll prepare the consolidated ZIP and start filling question-by-question in the questionnaire doc. If all goes well we should have a first pass by Thu EOD.
Riley Stone: FYI — procurement will need pricing for Dedicated with 99th pctl SLA and private deployment add-on. I flagged finance to prepare a ballpark.
Devon Park: For technical presales: customer asked if we can run a 2-week POC with a 4xV100 equivalent pool. I can scope infra and a minimal test harness.
Mina Ortiz: Security checklist for POC: ephemeral creds, network isolation, and SCIM for SSO if they want user-level access. I'll add those as requirements in the runbook.
Lara Chen: Thanks team. I'll update Northpoint with ETA and keep them in the loop. Ping here any docs you add so I can grab them into the SIG answers. :pray:
